transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we dive into the courtyard set discussion, I'd like to hear from each of your departments. We've got two options on the table — a masonry courtyard or a modular painted-timber courtyard — and the approved construction budget is $180,000. I need your structural, permit, stunt, and insurance reports before I can authorize fabrication to begin. Let's start with structural. What are your thoughts on the two approaches?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results from my load test yesterday. The masonry courtyard design would exceed Soundstage 3's 600 kilograms-per-square-meter floor limit, so that option is not viable from a structural standpoint. The modular painted-timber design does pass — but only if we install a 30-millimeter load-spreading deck. I should note that my written report is still in the engineering queue and hasn't been formally distributed yet.
